issues.detail: The Hebrew 'עִיר הַמָּיִם' means 'the city of waters' (i.e., the water supply/citadel of Rabbah), but the Vietnamese renders it as 'thành của các nước' ('city of the nations'), which is a mistranslation. The word 'מָּיִם' (waters) is incorrectly rendered as 'các nước' (nations), changing the meaning.
